findings.title: getCalendarCredentials now returns calendar promises but remains synchronous
findings.body: `getCalendar` was made async, but `getCalendarCredentials` still calls it synchronously and returns the promise as `calendar` in each result. `getConnectedCalendars` was patched to `await item.calendar`, but this exported function's contract silently changed: any other caller now receives a Promise where it previously received a Calendar and will call calendar methods on the promise. It also discards the promise entirely when `app.variant !== 'calendar'`, so a rejected dynamic import there becomes an unhandled rejection. Make `getCalendarCredentials` async and await the calendars (or update the type and every caller).

findings.title: Recurring calendar deletions can be omitted from apiDeletes
findings.body: In the recurring-cancellation branch the calendar credentials are processed with `.forEach(async ...)`, and the new `await getCalendar(credential)` is followed by `await calendar.deleteEvent(...)` before `apiDeletes.push(...)`. The `forEach` result is never awaited, so the handler reaches `await Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes))` while `apiDeletes` is still empty or partial; recurring calendar events can be left on calendars or deleted only after the response, and rejections become unhandled. Collect the callbacks in a `Promise.all` over `map` and await the delete promises there.

findings.title: Unawaited async forEach skips waiting for calendar event deletion
findings.body: `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async ...)` is not awaited. Since `getCalendar` is now awaited inside the callback, the function continues to `sendRequestRescheduleEmail` and returns before `getCalendar`/`deleteEvent` execute, and the surrounding try/catch cannot catch their rejections because they are floating promises. Use `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...))` and await the deletion calls.

findings.title: requestReschedule does not await async calendar deletions
findings.body: `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async ...)` is not awaited. The mutation can return before old calendar/video references are deleted, and rejections from the new `await getCalendar` or the returned `deleteEvent`/`deleteMeeting` calls are unhandled. Use `await Promise.all(bookingRefsFiltered.map(...))` and await the deletion promises.
